items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-18: Make your snacks
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Describe how to prepare for a safe, supervised classroom snack activity. Do not give stove or hot-oil instructions.
items.explanation:
Before our classroom snack activity, we wash our hands and clean the table. A responsible adult checks the ingredients, food allergies and storage conditions. We use clean utensils and wash the vegetables. The adult handles sharp knives and any cooking that is needed. We read the instructions and arrange the prepared ingredients in order. We do not taste raw egg or touch a hot pan. After the activity, we put food away safely and tidy the workspace. Following a sequence helps us learn English while adult supervision helps keep the activity safe.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original supervised-preparation model, not the textbook’s hot-oil recipe. Food allergies and adult supervision need attention before practical work.
